title: Documenso
descript: Documenso is a self-hosted document signing platform: upload a PDF, add fields, send it for signature and keep an audit trail, an open alternative to DocuSign. This package runs the upstream image (mirrored to Docker Hub by the maintainer) with its own PostgreSQL database as non-root containers. Only the x86_64 package is built because the mirrored image is amd64.
important: Open the web UI on port 8155 and sign up for the first account (the first user becomes admin), then create a document and send it. The stack contains two containers (app, PostgreSQL); the NextAuth secret is generated on first start. Data lives under /Volume1/DockerAppData/documensodocker/. Sending real emails needs SMTP settings, otherwise use the in-app links. Back up the data folder before uninstalling with data removal. Plain HTTP on the LAN.

github.description: A self-hosted habit tracking app without "Goals"

zh-cn.descript: 习惯打卡与连续天数统计，界面简洁。
zh-cn.important: 首次使用请打开网页完成初始化。数据保存在 DockerAppData/beaverhabitsdocker，重启和升级不会丢失。容器以 uid 1000 运行，挂载目录需对该用户可读。需要 DockerEngine；Docker Hub 不可达时先配置镜像加速。卸载并删除数据前请备份。局域网内为 HTTP。

zh-hk.descript: 习惯打卡与连续天数统计，界面简洁。
zh-hk.important: 首次使用請開啟網頁完成初始化。資料保存在 DockerAppData/beaverhabitsdocker，重新啟動和升級不會遺失。容器以 uid 1000 運行，掛載目錄需對該使用者可讀。需要 DockerEngine；Docker Hub 不可達時先設定鏡像加速。解除安裝並刪除資料前請備份。區域網路內為 HTTP。
